SANDEEP SAGAR

Site Reliability Engineer (T3/L2 Production Support)

sandeepsagar2007@gmail.com +91 9308583891| Bangalore, India www.linkedin.com/in/sandeepsagaritengg

Professional Summary Results-driven IT professional with 13+ years of experience in T3/L2 Production Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Enterprise Application Support across US Healthcare, Real Estate, and Education ERP domains. Experienced in supporting mission-critical ASP.NET/C# applications with expertise in SQL Server, incident management, application debugging, API troubleshooting, and enterprise system production integrations. Proven ability to perform technical triage, root cause analysis, and production monitoring while collaborating with Engineering teams for issue resolution. Strong experience leading small support teams, coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders, managing customer escalations, gathering business requirements, and ensuring successful delivery of production support initiatives. Proficient with Datadog, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, IIS, Windows Server, and ITIL processes while maintaining HIPAA compliance for healthcare applications.

Technical Skills

Programming & Scripting: ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server, HTML, CSS • Monitoring & Observability: Datadog, IIS Logs, Event Viewer, Blade Server Deployment, Log Viewer, Application Log Analysis, Performance Monitoring

Cloud & DevOps: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Windows Server, Application Pool (IIS) • Ticketing Systems: ServiceNow, Azure DevOps (ADO), FreshDesk • Database: SQL Server, Complex SQL Queries, Stored Procedure Analysis, Data Validation • Tools: Confluence, Postman, GitHub, JIRA • Compliance: HIPAA Privacy and Security Training • Certification: Azure Az-900 • APIs & Integration: API Debugging, Inbound & Outbound Interface Validation, Postman, REST APIs • Production Support & Application Support: T3/L2 Production Support, Incident Management, RCA, Technical Triage, Application Debugging, Log Analysis, SQL Debugging, Defect Analysis, KB Documentation • Domain Expertise:

1. Healthcare Technologies: US Healthcare Application, HIPAA Compliance, CodeMetro, EchoVantage, Funding Source Management, Billing Provider, Office Ally, Apex Integration, Catalyst SOAP Notes.

2. Real Estate Applications: Service Insight (SI7), Mainstream, Vendor Management, Service Request Management

3. Education ERP: Student Information Systems, Academic & Administrative Workflow Support, ERP Application Support, Payroll, Admission, Fees, Examination

• AI Assisted Support: Log Analysis, SQL Analysis, Root Cause Analysis •

ITIL: Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Release Management

Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Team Leadership, Technical Mentoring, Cross-functional, Collaboration, Stakeholder Communication, Customer Coordination, Requirement Gathering, Production Escalation Management, Client Communication, Workload Prioritization

Professional Experience

➢ Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands) – TietoEvry India Pvt Ltd Site Reliability Engineer – T3/L2 Production Support Team Handled: 7

2023 – Present

Provide T3/L2 production support for CodeMetro and EchoVantage healthcare applications serving US healthcare providers.

• Analyze and troubleshoot production incidents escalated from the L1 Support team through detailed

technical investigation.

• Reproduce production issues in lower environments to validate reported defects and identify root

causes.

Debug ASP.NET/C# application workflows, backend logic, and SQL Server stored procedures to isolate application issues.

Perform SQL data analysis, Investigate complex queries, and validate backend data to troubleshoot



production defects. Investigate REST API requests/responses and monitor healthcare integration workflows using Postman and application logs.

Monitor and troubleshoot integrations involving:

1. Funding Source 2. Billing Provider 3. Office Ally 4. Apex 5. Catalyst SOAP Notes (SOAP Web Services)

Analyze inbound and outbound interface transactions to identify data mismatches, processing failures,



and integration issues. Investigate production issues using Datadog dashboards, IIS Logs, Windows Event Viewer, application logs, and SQL Server.

Perform technical triage by consolidating application, database, and integration findings before escalating validated defects to the Engineering (L3) team.

Collaborate with Engineering, QA, Product Owners, Customer Support, and Business teams during critical production incidents and application outages.

Support production deployments through post-release validation and production health verification. • Prepare detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports and maintain knowledge base articles for recurring issues.

Participate in Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes using Azure DevOps following ITIL practices.

Ensure HIPAA privacy and security compliance while handling healthcare production incidents. • Utilize AI-assisted tools to accelerate log analysis, SQL investigation, and production incident troubleshooting.

Key Achievements: • Reduced recurring production incidents through comprehensive RCA documentation and proactive

monitoring. Improved production support efficiency by automating repetitive operational activities.

• Successfully supported multiple critical production incidents while maintaining SLA compliance. • Enhanced collaboration between Support and Engineering teams through structured defect analysis and technical documentation.

➢ CBRE (Real Estate Project) – TietoEvry India Pvt Ltd

Senior Software Engineer- (Sr. L2 Production Support SME) Team Handled: 4

2021 – 2023

Supported and enhanced the Service Insight (SI7) application for vendor management and service requests.

Provided L2 production support for enterprise ASP.NET applications hosted on IIS. • Investigated production issues through SQL Server, IIS Logs, Windows Event Viewer, and Datadog monitoring.

Debugged application behavior and backend data issues before coordinating with Development teams for permanent resolution.

Supported production deployments, release validation, and application health monitoring. • Worked extensively with ServiceNow for Incident, Problem, Feature, and Change Management. • Participated in requirement gathering and coordinated with business stakeholders for production enhancements.

• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to resolve customer-impacting production incidents.

• Followed ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, and Change Management.

Key Achievements:

Achieved 30% reduction in incident resolution time through proactive root-cause identification and

optimization.

Enhanced system uptime through robust support practices.

➢ Mihira Technology

IT Manager (Delivery & Support)

Team Handled: 35

2020 – 2021



Led a technical team of 30+ members, overseeing end-to-end project delivery and client engagement activities.

Actively interacted with customers to gather project requirements, manage scope changes, and ensure quality deliverables.

Successfully delivered 5+ projects including Vendor Management System, School Management System (ERP), Pharma Management System, etc.

Streamlined customer communication and project documentation for better requirement tracking and delivery.

Key Achievements:

Onboarded 27+ clients and delivered strategic IT projects on-time and within budget. • Improved client satisfaction through transparent communication and proactive issue resolution.

➢ MasterSoft ERP Solutions Pvt Ltd

Application Deployment Engineer (Education Management System)

2016 – 2020

Specialized in Educational ERP deployments across top institutes like NIT Jamshedpur. • Deployed applications on Blade Servers using IIS Application Pools and conducted rigorous performance testing.

Acted as the bridge between clients and development teams, capturing new requirements, creating

meaningful presentations for developers, and ensuring approval of functional specifications. • Handled incident resolution, requirement gathering, deployment planning, and post-deployment

support.

Key Achievements:

Reduced deployment errors by 25% through structured deployment and validation processes. • Strengthened client relationships through accurate issue resolution and proactive requirement management.

➢ United Air Express (Tata Steel Project)

System Engineer

2013 – 2015

Supported IT infrastructure for CRMIS (Coil Rolling Mill Information System) at Tata Steel, ensuring high

availability during critical operations.

Managed system configurations, network troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance activities.

Education Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) in Computer Science

2009 – 2013 | CGPA: 6.87
